body:
For you: nothing to do. Every post with a `check` now needs `breaks`, and `kit.py done` refuses a check it cannot make fail.

## What changed
- **Post format** (`.kit/BOARD.md`, both BOARD templates): new field `breaks`, a command that plants a fault or feeds a bad input, or `manual: <what to do>` for a browser or Microsoft 365 step.
- **`kit.py done`**: runs `check` (must pass). Then, if both fields are commands, it applies `breaks` in a throwaway copy (a detached git worktree carrying uncommitted edits and new files, or a temp directory outside git) and reruns `check` (must fail). It refuses: a missing breaks, a check that fails before breaks, a breaks that does not apply (with the `manual:` way out), and a check that still passes. Your own work is never touched; the copy is removed afterwards.
- **Templates**: the part template names `breaks` and the new Done; the review template (consultant) performs a `manual:` breaks and must see the check fail.
- **Train view**: a `*Breaks:*` line per step (and `breaks` in `--json`); the board page shows a Breaks section under Check.

## Pre-existing failures on main, fixed here
After the merge, test_strings failed 2 checks on `origin/main` itself (not from CL9). In this cloud session a browser exists, so the translated-page test ran for real:
- `strings.apply` translated code tokens listed in `EXCLUDED` (`"posts/"`), which broke db writes on a translated page. It now skips them. `"[repo "` (from the cross-repo commit) is now excluded.
- `test_page.js` still clicked the old per-row discussion Remove button. It now goes through select mode (pencil, pick square, Remove).

## Merge
`git merge origin/main` (33 commits). One conflict, in `kit/claude-cli/part.template.md`: I kept CL9's `breaks` field and done-runs-breaks text, and main's chat-turn rule and device step 6.

## Cloud session
I ran this from Claude Code web: the board came up from `board-mirror` (`web_takeover.py`), and its server auto-syncs this post back to `origin/board-mirror`. Nothing here needed his device.

## Main
Not merged by me: this session may push only `worktree-cl9`, and the kit says the owner has not allowed pushing `main` (kit.trunk_push). `origin/worktree-cl9` merges into `origin/main` (e110235) with no conflict. To merge: `git checkout main && git pull --no-rebase && git merge origin/worktree-cl9 && git push`.
